$comment: Every unit-bearing number the English home page renders, and the line it comes out of.
scripts/check-implantplan.mjs (check 14) scans the rendered text of / plus its aria-label, alt and title
attributes with the `regex` below, skipping the live readout (it moves with the scroll), prices, clock times,
the SHA-256 and the film transcript (verbatim film text). Each match must equal an entry's `text`
(whitespace collapsed, a decimal comma read as a point), and each entry's `file` (repo-relative) at `line`
must contain `pattern` literally. With `digits`, the last number in `pattern` rounded to that many places
must equal the rendered number: 0.5354 is what the page shows as 0.54, so a re-bake that moves the crossing
fails here instead of leaving the page quoting the old figure.
`line: null` means the source file is being written in this release and the line is not frozen yet: the
check searches the whole file, passes if the pattern is there, and prints the line to pin.
Adding a row is a claim that the figure is measured. If no file in the repo holds it, cut the figure.
